_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Small Arms Serialization Program (SASP) Transaction Card
summary: This DID provides the report of movement of weapons recorded in the Small Arms Serialization Program to audit movement of weapons in the DOD Small Arms Central Registry.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) provides the report of movement of weapons record in the SASP. The SASP transaction is used to audit movement of weapons recorded in the Department of Defense (DOD) Small Arms Central Registry. This program controls all Small Arms defined as follows:
Handguns
Shoulder-fired weapons
Light Automatic weapons up to and including .50 caliber machine guns
Recoilless Rifles up to and including 106MM
Mortars up to and including 81MM
Rocket Launchers, man-portable
Grenade Launchers, rifle and shoulder fired
Individual operated weapons which are portable and/or can be fired without special mounts or firing devices and which have potential use in civil disturbances or are vulnerable to theft.
All weapons meeting this definition, regardless of origin, excluding weapons assigned to classified activities will be reported. Included would be foreign and commercial weapons, and museum pieces.

Small Arms, including those mounted in aircraft and vehicles will be reported, whether or not assigned a stock number and/or serial number.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the Scope of Work.

This DID supersedes DI-MISC-80914A, dated 7/24/1991.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: SASP transactions shall be 80 record positions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The SASP transaction content shall be in accordance with the following instructions:

children.title: For all transaction codes, F, N, P, R, S, and V
Weapon Serial Number
children.content: The weapon serial number is placed in this data field, left justified with remaining characters filled with spaces. There must be 11 characters total (WSN + spaces) for the data element.

children.title: Transaction date
children.content: The transaction date is an ordinal date comprised of the last two digits of the calendar Year and the Julian day of the year. Example: 30 Jan 07 shall be written 07030.

children.title: "F" transaction code
children.content: The "F" transaction code is for all Foreign Military Sales (FMS) shipments to the Freight forwarder from any/or all locations. Must be a valid FMS document number and begin with a B (ex: BY8B9561089001).

children.title: "N" transaction code
children.content: The "N" transaction code is used to report shipments to civilian activities, non-DOD Governmental activities and non-reporting (classified) military activities.

children.title: "K" transaction code
children.content: The "K" transaction code is used to correct the NSN and/or owner DODAAC, and/or WSN in a previously submitted transaction. Only the "corrected field" being modified in record positions 42-56, 58-63, and/or 65-75 should be filled.

children.title: NSN/MCN
children.content: NSN/MCN must be in UIT reportable reference table.
